race.comment: ELSKA (7) has to rebound from a plain Wyong run, but she is eased from provincial company, gets first-time blinkers and did have a forgive point two back when not fully tested at Newcastle. Go close. BRIGHT EYED BABY (11) Profiteer filly on debut for the Jake Hull yard. Makes her debut off an easy Beaumont (Newcastle) trial win over 800m. Blinkers go on and will appreciate the claim. LEADING PLAYER. MAXIMUM TORQUE (5) is a debut runner by Power from the Lane yard, with the cleanest trial profile after a solid second at Beaumont (Newcastle). Warrants respect without having the race-day grounding. Respect. TIME FOR MARY (12) is a Capitalist filly from the Bartley stable on debut. Fitted with the two recent 800m trials, with the latest at Beaumont (Newcastle) providing some fitness but no standout pointer. Well drawn and must be kept safe.
